decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times - 10.00am to 10.30pm Monday to Saturday, and 10.00am to 9.30pm Sundays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.

Condition : 4 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use from retail shop (A1) to restaurant (A3) incorporating external ducting and new shop front to premises.
